customer_updates.name: Irfan khan
customer_updates.text: I genuinely feel that Rustomjee Crown is a premium residential gated community in a prime central location, offering high-quality construction and top-tier amenities. Considering the rates of comparable developments in surrounding areas, the pricing seems fairly justified.

featured_reviews.name: Sunil Verghese
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rustomjee Crown Tower C ,
We are  incredibly impressed with the progress and the nearing possession at Rustomjee Crown. The attention to detail in the architecture and amenities truly set a new benchmark for luxury living in Prabhadevi.

The Rustomjee team, A special mention to Mr. Zubin Patel , Mr Roger D’Souza and Mr. Bradley D’Souza  for their  proactive communication and assistance , they have been professional throughout the journey, and seeing the project come to life is a testament to their commitment to quality. Looking forward to moving into what is easily one of the most iconic addresses in South Mumbai."
The 'Rustomjee Service' has been a highlight—transparent communication and a genuine sense of being part of a community rather than just a real estate transaction.

Sunil Verghese

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Dhuri
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have had an exceptional experience with Rustomjee Crown since the day I booked my apartment. Their service is incredibly prompt, and they have always been accommodating with last-minute site visit requests while consistently prioritizing safety and security measures on-site.
What truly sets them apart is their transparency; the back-office support and documentation process have been seamless and professional throughout.
The Rustomjee Crown project is shaping up beautifully and is undoubtedly set to become a premier landmark of South Mumbai.
A special mention to Zubin, Warren, Bradley, and Deepak for being so responsive. I’ve developed a special bond with Zubin, who has guided me like a true friend through every step of this journey.
As the project nears completion, I am eagerly looking forward to taking possession and moving into our new home with my family. I highly recommend Rustomjee for anyone looking for a premium property and a truly professional, welcoming experience!

featured_reviews.review_text: Great project by Rustomjee. sharing latest elevation photo.

featured_reviews.name: Anthony Dsilwa
featured_reviews.review_text:
. . . . From the 60th floor of Rustomjee Crown, Prabhadevi, the city unfolds like a living canvas. Each cloud, each tower, each whisper of rain framed by quiet luxury.
This 4BHK sanctuary begins at ₹14 Cr, but its true worth lies in the perspective it offers. A skyline that doesn’t just impress—it listens, reflects, and elevates.
Here, elegance isn’t built it’s breathed in.

#MumbaiRealEstate #RustomjeeCrown @rustomjee_spaces
